_about: Cases the evaluator's value screen (app/validation.py) and the inspector's (lib/inspector/valueshape.mjs) must agree on. Canonical: the evaluator owns this file; the CLI keeps a pinned copy under test/fixtures/contracts/ with the source commit noted. Synthetic, no real data. kind path_segment: a walked path, sent with ids.sentPath; kind name: a captured table name, sent with captures.computeTableName. expect kept: sent as written, and record_value_spans finds nothing. expect hashed: the inspector hashes it, the evaluator need not refuse the raw text. expect <label>: record_value_spans gives that label, and the inspector hashes it. Words: app/knowledge/value_screen_words.json.
